signals.text: Participants need a way to lock a workspace and finalize results.
External agents need a secure mechanism to retrieve session data only after closure, with enforcement of status checks.
signals.possible_indication: Ensures data consistency by preventing access to incomplete sessions.

DISCOVER.core_issue: Participants need a way to conclude a collaborative session, and external agents require a secure, restricted mechanism to retrieve finalized session data.
DISCOVER.impact_value: Enables formal session closure, prevents premature data retrieval, and integrates quadra results into external workflows.
DISCOVER.discovery_method: Analysis of project requirements for session lifecycle management and data accessibility.
DISCOVER.pattern_dependencies: The session status transition is the gating mechanism for the secure retrieval of session data.

pattern_narratives.current_state: Session status is currently implicitly 'open' and mutable.
